fitments.heading: Fitment curation
fitments.noMatch: No matching Part. Create a new one:
fitments.step2Hint: Pick the vehicles this part belongs to. Years here pick vehicles by their production years. Fill in at least one filter: the part is attached to every matching vehicle and existing fitments are not duplicated.
fitments.notePlaceholder: Note for the customer, e.g. M Sport package only
fitments.noteHint: The note is translated at Publish. A Part with a note is confirmed by the customer.
fitments.confirmDeletePartBody: All its numbers, supplier offers and fitments go with it. This cannot be undone.
fitments.confirmDeleteNumberBody: The number page leaves the site at the next publish and supplier offers for it are deleted. The part stays.
fitments.step3Hint: Conditions describe the fitting itself: dates here mean the part fits only cars built in that period.
fitments.confirmDetachTitle: Detach the part from the matching vehicles?
fitments.confirmDetachBody: Every fitment of {{name}} on a vehicle matching the filters is deleted, whatever its conditions.
fitments.lastNumberBody: A part without a number cannot be found, so its last number cannot be deleted alone. Delete the part {{name}} entirely, with its fitments and supplier offers? This cannot be undone.
fitments.quantityInvalid: Enter the quantity as a whole number from 1 to 100.

suppliers.heading: Suppliers
suppliers.importLead: Supplier catalogues are imported every night before publishing. The import takes only mapped categories and Brands with this supplier's spellings.
suppliers.importNoAdapters: No supplier has its import switched on
suppliers.releasedHint: Checked data is shown on the site. Check it only once the supplier has allowed it in writing: this data may come from TecDoc.

mappings.heading: Supplier categories
mappings.lead: Map the supplier's categories to our Categories. Goods in unmapped categories are not imported.
mappings.empty: Map the first category with the form below.
mappings.confirmRemoveBody: The next import skips this supplier category.

suppliers.markupSaved: {{supplier}} markup: {{markup}}%. Site prices update at the next publish.
suppliers.confirmReleaseBody: Buyers see this data right away. Turn it on only with the supplier's written permission: the data may come from TecDoc.
suppliers.released: "{{kind}}" from {{supplier}} now shows on the site.
suppliers.hidden: "{{kind}}" from {{supplier}} is hidden from the site.
suppliers.markupRequired: Enter the markup as a number from 0 to 500 with at most two decimals, for example 20 or 12.5.
suppliers.importWithoutPrice: Without an RSD price, added with no offer: {{count}}.

off.title: Switch off the import from {{supplier}}?
off.body: The nightly import and Import now will stop loading this supplier's catalogue. Parts and offers with price and stock already loaded stay on the site. To remove them, delete this supplier's rows under Catalogue data sources below.
off.done: Import from {{supplier}} switched off. Its offers stay on the site.

on.title: Switch on the import from {{supplier}}?
on.body: The next import loads this supplier's catalogue again, rows removed earlier included.

suppliers.importSwitchedOff: Import switched off, not loaded: {{suppliers}}. Their earlier offers stay on the site.

brands.heading: Brands
brands.slugHint: The slug is part of every part number page URL and never changes: lower-case Latin letters, digits and hyphens.
brands.empty: No brands yet. Add one before creating parts.
brands.confirmDeleteBody: The brand goes with its supplier spellings. A brand that has part numbers cannot be deleted.
brands.confirmSpellingBody: The next import skips this supplier's articles with this brand spelling.

vehicles.heading: Vehicles and reference data
vehicles.confirmDelete: A reference row other rows point at cannot be deleted.
vehicles.identifierFormat: BMW type code: 4 letters or digits, for example 35BG. Mercedes-Benz Baumuster: 6 digits, for example 213004.
vehicles.emptyHint: Click Add to create the first one.

vinLookups.heading: Unresolved VINs
vinLookups.lead: Codes from VINs customers searched for that match no Vehicle in the catalogue, most frequent first. Add them under Vehicles.
vinLookups.empty: Every VIN customers searched for was resolved.
vinLookups.confirmDismissBody: Lookups with this code leave the list. If a customer searches such a VIN again, the code comes back.

publish.heading: Publish
publish.description: Publishing first imports the supplier catalogues, then translates new catalogue texts into Serbian and English, rebuilds and deploys carlab.rs and updates search. Each step runs only after the previous one succeeds.
publish.empty: Nothing has been published yet. Press Publish to put your edits live.

knownErrors.openAiKey: The OpenAI key (OPENAI_API_KEY) is not set, so translation did not run and the later steps were skipped. This is a server setting: ask a developer to add the key.
knownErrors.dispatchToken: The site deploy token (PUBLISH_DISPATCH_TOKEN) is not set, so the site was not rebuilt and search was not updated. This is a server setting: ask a developer to add the token.

supersession.heading: Supersession
supersession.intro: Mark an outdated number or name the part that replaced this one. The old number keeps leading buyers to the current part.
supersession.replacementCleared: Replacement removed: {{part}} no longer replaces this part.

categories.heading: Categories
categories.slugHint: The slug is part of the Category page URL and never changes: lower-case latin letters, digits and dashes.
categories.empty: No Categories yet. Add the first one to describe parts.
categories.name: Name
categories.textHint: Shown on the Category page and on every part page in it. Write in Russian; translations arrive at Publish.
categories.fieldsHint: Field and option keys never change once created. Renaming an option leaves parts intact. A field or option that parts use cannot be deleted.
categories.noFields: This Category has no fields yet.
categories.keyHint: Key: lower-case latin letters, digits and dashes.
categories.maintenanceKitHint: The car page puts one fitting part from each flagged category into the maintenance kit. A lower place puts it higher in the list.
categories.confirmDeleteOptionBody: An option picked on parts or needed by requirements cannot be deleted.
categories.confirmDeleteFieldBody: An attribute used by parts or requirements cannot be deleted.
categories.confirmDeleteCategoryBody: The category goes with its attributes. A category with parts cannot be deleted.
categories.serviceLabelPlaceholder: For example, Battery registration in the control unit
categories.serviceNotePlaceholder: For example, on BMW and Mercedes-Benz a new battery has to be registered with the control unit
categories.serviceHint: Shoppers can add the service to every part of this category in the cart. The price comes only from here, in whole dinars. Shoppers see the note on part and car pages next to the service price; leave it empty to show no note. To drop the service, clear the name and the price and save.

requirements.heading: Requirements for consumables
requirements.hint: A requirement says which universal goods fit a car: oil approval, capacity, wiper length. Engine and chassis requirements apply to every car with them, and a car's own requirements add to them.
requirements.pickOwner: Choose an engine, chassis or vehicle to see and add its requirements.
requirements.confirmDeleteBody: Consumables stop matching by this requirement after the next publish.
requirements.boundsInverted: «From» is greater than «To». Swap the values.

codes.IN_USE: This row cannot be deleted: other catalogue data refers to it. Delete or move that data first.
codes.REQUIREMENT_IN_USE: Requirements use this characteristic or option. Delete them on the Requirements page first.
codes.SOURCE_IN_USE: This source cannot be removed: data from other sources refers to it. Delete or move that data first.
codes.UNKNOWN_BRAND: This brand does not exist. Pick a brand from the list.
codes.DUPLICATE_FITMENT: This part already fits this vehicle at that position with these conditions.
codes.REPLACEMENT_CYCLE: A part cannot be replaced so that the chain of replacements leads back to it.
codes.INVALID_ATTRIBUTES: The characteristic values do not fit the category: check required fields and options.
codes.INVALID_REQUIREMENT: The requirement does not fit the characteristic: check the options and the From and To values.
codes.DEFINITION_BREAKS_PARTS: The change would break the characteristics of parts in this category. Fix those parts first.
codes.PUBLISH_RUNNING: A publish run is already in progress. Wait for it to finish.
codes.LAST_IDENTIFIER: This is the part's last number and a part cannot be found without one. Add another number or delete the whole part.
codes.MANUAL_SOURCE: Manually entered rows cannot be removed by source. Delete them one by one in their sections.
codes.INVALID_IMAGE: This file cannot be used: upload a JPEG, PNG or WebP photo.
codes.IMAGE_TOO_LARGE: The photo is over 10 MB. Make it smaller and upload it again.

types.invalid_data: Check the data you entered: the server did not accept it.
types.not_found: The row was not found. Reload the page.
types.not_allowed: This action is not available now.
types.conflict: The row has changed or is in use. Reload the page and try again.
types.unauthorized: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
types.forbidden: You do not have permission for this action.

errors.unknown: The server could not complete the action. Try again.
errors.unexpectedAnswer: The server answered in an unexpected shape. Reload the page.
errors.unreachable: The server cannot be reached. Check the connection and try again.

alreadyExists.brand: A brand with this name or link address already exists.
alreadyExists.brand_spelling: This supplier already has this brand spelling (case and spaces do not matter).
alreadyExists.part_identifier: This brand already has this number. One brand number belongs to one part, whatever the number type.
alreadyExists.make: A make with this name or link address already exists.
alreadyExists.series: This make already has this series.
alreadyExists.chassis: A chassis with this code already exists.
alreadyExists.vehicle_model: A model with this link address already exists.
alreadyExists.engine: An engine with this code already exists.
alreadyExists.vehicle_identifier: This code is already linked to a vehicle.
alreadyExists.category: A category with this name or link address already exists.
alreadyExists.category_field: This category already has an attribute with this key.
alreadyExists.category_field_option: This attribute already has an option with this key.
alreadyExists.supplier_category: This supplier category is already mapped.
alreadyExists.fitment: This part already fits this vehicle at this position with these conditions.
alreadyExists.requirement: This owner already has a requirement on this attribute. Change or delete it instead of adding another.
alreadyExists.supplier: A supplier with this name already exists.
alreadyExists.vehicle: This vehicle already exists: same model, engine, power, drive, market, years and steering.
alreadyExists.category_field_option_label: This attribute already has an option with this label (case does not matter).
alreadyExists.part_identifier_held: This number already belongs to the part «{{part}}». A brand number can belong to one part only: open that part or enter another number.

invalidFields.key: Key: lowercase Latin letters, digits and hyphens. The keys brand, in-stock and price are taken by the storefront filters.
invalidFields.year_to: The "to" year is before the "from" year. Check the years.
invalidFields.production_to: Production ends before it starts. Check the dates.
invalidFields.markup_percentage: Markup: a number from 0 to 500 with at most two decimals.
invalidFields.production_from: The production start date is not a valid date. Pick it in the calendar.
invalidFields.service_price: Service price: a whole number of RSD from 0 to 1000000.
invalidFields.ean: EAN barcode: 8 or 13 digits with a valid check digit. Check the number on the package.
invalidFields.quantity: Quantity: a whole number from 1 to 100.
invalidFields.power_kw: Power: a whole number of kW from 1 to 2000.
invalidFields.displacement_cc: Displacement: a whole number of cc from 1 to 20000.
invalidFields.slug: URL name: lowercase Latin letters and digits with hyphens between them, for example skoda-octavia.

errors.attributeLabel: The value of «{{label}}» does not fit: check it is filled in, picked from the options and not negative.
errors.inUseBy: This row cannot be deleted, it is referenced by: {{holders}}. Delete or move them first.
errors.sourceUsedBy: This source cannot be removed: rows of other sources depend on it ({{holders}}). Delete or move them first.
errors.sourceBlocked: This source cannot be removed: rows of other sources refer to its {{entity}}. Delete or move them first.

sources.heading: Catalogue data sources
sources.lead: How many catalogue rows came from each source. If the rights to a source are lost, its rows can be removed at once.
sources.confirmBody_one: {{count}} row will be removed. It cannot be restored.
sources.confirmBody_other: {{count}} rows will be removed. They cannot be restored.
sources.empty: Rows appear after the first import or manual entry.
sources.confirmSupplierBody_one: {{count}} row will be removed and the import from this supplier switched off, so the next import does not bring it back. It cannot be restored.
sources.confirmSupplierBody_other: {{count}} rows will be removed and the import from this supplier switched off, so the next import does not bring them back. They cannot be restored.

translations.heading: Serbian and English translations
translations.lead: A corrected translation is kept until the Russian text changes. An empty field leaves the translation as it is.
translations.nothingChanged: No translation changed, nothing to save.

images.categoryHint: Shown in listings in place of a part's photo when the part has none.
images.hint: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 10 MB. The first photo is the main one.
images.hintSingle: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 10 MB.
images.confirmDeleteBody: The photo leaves the site with the next publish. The file is deleted right away and cannot be restored.
images.wrongType: "{{name}}" cannot be used: upload a JPEG, PNG or WebP.
images.tooLarge: "{{name}}" is over 10 MB. Make it smaller and upload it again.
images.altPreview: Text for search engines and screen readers: "{{alt}}"
images.numberHint: A photo belongs to one number: it must show this brand's part. Equivalents have their own photos.

parts.heading: Parts
parts.lead: A number is indexed when it has a category and at least one vehicle, equivalent or matching approval. Only indexed numbers reach search and the sitemap.
parts.emptyHint: Change the filter or the search.
